title: AI and CI authority: who may start the agent, what each job holds, who may sign
note: D-2026-146 (CI-4). Each mutation deletes one rule of tools/workflow_contract.py ai_authority_problems, or (CA14-CA18, D-2026-152) of vacuous_exit_captures; tests/test_ci_authority.py breaks that rule in a parsed copy of the real workflows and requires it reported. These rules govern the files on this branch; the deployed agent runs the default branch's file, which is an owner action (docs/security/owner_actions.md).

mutations.name: CA1_any_author_may_start_the_agent
mutations.find: if gate not in cond or not all(f in cond for f in fields):
mutations.rationale: CI-1: the agent's job condition need not name who may start it

mutations.name: CA2_the_gate_may_be_a_disjunct
mutations.find: elif not cond.rstrip().endswith(")") or ") && (" not in cond:
mutations.rationale: the author gate is accepted although the condition is an OR around it

mutations.name: CA3_the_agent_may_admit_bots
mutations.find:
for opt in AGENT_OPTIONS_FORBIDDEN:
                        if opt in w:
mutations.replace:
for opt in AGENT_OPTIONS_FORBIDDEN:
                        if False:
mutations.rationale: allowed_bots / allowed_non_write_users reopen the job to anyone

mutations.name: CA4_the_agent_may_check_out_a_pr_head
mutations.find: if name == AGENT_WORKFLOW and "ref" in w:
mutations.rationale: a PR head checked out at the root runs untrusted code beside the key

mutations.name: CA5_a_job_may_hold_more_than_it_states
mutations.rationale: any job may widen its token; only the default-deny top level is checked

mutations.name: CA6_the_top_level_may_grant
mutations.rationale: a workflow without default-deny hands every job the repository's default token

mutations.name: CA7_pull_request_target_is_allowed
mutations.rationale: a fork's input runs with this repository's secrets

mutations.name: CA8_checkouts_may_keep_their_token
mutations.rationale: the job's token is left in .git/config for every later step to read

mutations.name: CA9_event_text_may_become_shell
mutations.find:
if isinstance(run, str) and re.search(
                        r"\$\{\{\s*github\.event\.", run):
mutations.replace:
if False and re.search(
                        r"\$\{\{\s*github\.event\.", run):
mutations.rationale: a comment body interpolated into a run: block is script injection

mutations.name: CA10_any_workflow_may_name_a_secret
mutations.find: if not (name == AGENT_WORKFLOW and ref == AGENT_SECRET):
mutations.rationale: a secret reaches a job that has no reason to hold it

mutations.name: CA11_the_ci_signer_may_run_on_tags
mutations.find: if isinstance(push, dict) and "tags" in push:
mutations.rationale: the CI signer signs on the trigger a release uses

mutations.name: CA12_the_agent_may_be_a_release_signer
mutations.rationale: nothing holds the release-policy loader to refusing the agent's and the CI signer's identities

mutations.name: CA13_the_contract_skips_the_authority_rules
mutations.find: out += [f"AI/CI authority -- {x}" for x in ai_authority_problems()]
mutations.rationale: problems() -- what CI runs -- no longer asks the authority rules

mutations.name: CA14_a_status_read_under_errexit_is_never_reported
mutations.rationale: D-2026-152: a step that reads $? after a command bash -e would already have stopped on passes the contract

mutations.name: CA15_a_named_bash_or_sh_shell_is_exempt
mutations.rationale: D-2026-152: naming the shell GitHub runs with -e anyway exempts the step

mutations.name: CA16_a_job_default_shell_is_ignored
mutations.rationale: D-2026-152: every step whose shell comes from a job or workflow default is skipped, whatever that shell is

mutations.name: CA17_any_set_line_exempts_the_step
mutations.find: if any(re.match(r"\s*set\s+\+e\b", x) for x in lines):
mutations.replace: if any(re.match(r"\s*set\b", x) for x in lines):
mutations.rationale: D-2026-152: `set -uo pipefail`, which leaves -e on, is read as turning it off -- the shipped defect's own first line

mutations.name: CA18_the_contract_skips_the_exit_rule
mutations.find: out += [f"vacuous exit check -- {x}" for x in vacuous_exit_captures()]
mutations.rationale: D-2026-152: the workflow-contract step CI runs never applies the rule
